reasons: The cited text (p0077) is genuinely a one-way cap protecting only TrueLink, leaving Client's liability (including its broad Section 12a indemnity) uncapped — squarely the rule's walk-away scenario, so 'deviation' is correctly claimed.

The redline reaches the preferred position: mutual aggregate cap at the greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, mutual indirect/consequential exclusion, and uncapped Excluded Claims for confidentiality/data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement, plus the carve-out that Client's fee obligations are not capped damages.

The original carve-out for TrueLink's gross negligence/wilful misconduct is preserved (now mutual) within the Excluded Claims definition, and the ALL-CAPS formatting of the source paragraph is retained.

The failed 'minimal edit' check is explained by the rule itself: the cap basis, mutuality and carve-out sentence all had to be rewritten; the edit stays within the single existing sentence rather than restructuring the section.

Comment is accurate, correctly states the playbook position and the 12-months'-fees fallback with carve-outs retained. Minor note only: the edit drops the original narrowing to Sections 3, 4, 7 and 11, which incidentally extends the cap to TrueLink's other breaches — acceptable here because it matches the model language and is offset by the broad Excluded Claims, but worth flagging to the negotiator.
